text:
Greetings dear colleagues,
Just now, the relief planner mentioned a point about handover calls

I need everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to treat that as an immediate reminder. When we pass animal bookings between shifts, the details have to stay clean, calm, and complete. If a traveler has a pet needing special care, note the handling approach, crate condition, feeding notes, and any movement concerns without softening the facts or leaving gaps. Aurelia Skyways depends on us to keep companion travel dependable, and sloppy handovers put both animals and passengers at risk.

Please check every open file before you leave your desk and make sure the next person can step in without guessing. If you worked with Leila Mori, Theo Clark, or any other traveler today, confirm the status is written clearly and that anything unusual is easy to spot at once. Handlers should continue using calm, humane methods around animals, and we need the record to match that standard. If something looks off, flag it right away instead of waiting for the next shift to notice.

This is not a comfort note, it is a safety one. The desk runs smoothly only when we keep our updates honest, brief, and useful. Keep the next call clear, keep the notes readable, and keep the animals steady through every changeover.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
